input.summary: Implemented a TypeScript Task Management API with in-memory services and an in-memory event bus. Files added: src/types.ts, src/utils.ts, src/event-bus.ts, src/services/user-service.ts, src/services/project-service.ts, src/services/task-service.ts, src/services/comment-service.ts, src/services/notification-service.ts, src/router.ts, src/main.ts, src/demo.ts, src/node-shims.d.ts, and tsconfig.json. The system compiles with tsc --noEmit. The demo (src/demo.ts) starts the server, runs through creating users, project, members, tasks, status changes, comments, and verifies notifications.
